LESSON: SELECTED SURAH

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Selected surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected surah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons)
2. Use the selected surah in  Learners use flashcards and a pocket board to Swalah. sort and arrange the verses of the selected Surah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SELECTED SURAH
This lesson teaches Selected surah for Grade 3 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Use the selected surah in  Learners use flashcards and a pocket board to Swalah. sort and arrange the verses of the selected Surah
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Selected surah using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Selected surah above.
2. Explain Selected surah to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Selected surah.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected surah with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Selected surah important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Recite the selected surah  Organize learners in class, groups, pairs, or as  Kafirun correctly. individuals, to read the selected Surah repeatedly (12 lessons)
2. Use the selected surah in  Learners use flashcards and a pocket board to Swalah. sort and arrange the verses of the selected Surah
